scripts.predev: powershell -Command "@(3000,24678) | ForEach-Object { $p=(netstat -ano | Select-String \":$_\" | Select-String 'LISTENING'); if($p){ $pid=($p -split '\s+')[-1]; Stop-Process -Id $pid -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Write-Host \"Freed port $_\" } }"
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:api
scripts.test:smoke: k6 run -e BASE_URL=http://localhost:3000 -e ADMIN_USER=admin -e ADMIN_PASS=admin123 load-tests/scenarios/smoke.js
scripts.test:load:1k: k6 run -e BASE_URL=%BASE_URL% -e ADMIN_USER=%ADMIN_USER% -e ADMIN_PASS=%ADMIN_PASS% --out json=load-tests/results/1k-result.json load-tests/scenarios/load-1k.js
